root_cause: The production Composio Project API key was updated at 2026-09-22T08:15:34Z, after the currently active Netlify Functions deployment. The live function therefore still validated the prior credential until a later Functions deployment occurred.
prevention_rule: When a production credential is rotated after the active Functions deployment, force one new protected Functions deployment after the rotation timestamp before provider validation. Compare credential updated_at with deployment published_at and fail closed when deployment is older.
evidence: Netlify COMPOSIO_API_KEY updated_at is 2026-09-22T08:15:34Z with production/functions/runtime scopes.
The active Netlify production deployment predates the latest credential rotation.
A direct authenticated sync-now canary before the post-rotation rebuild still returned COMPOSIO_API_KEY_REJECTED.
terminal_rule: LIVE_BEWEZEN only after exact-head gates, protected merge, Netlify production deployment published after 2026-09-22T08:15:34Z, successful provider validation, and Supabase setup-state readback.
